description: Source code implementing rational number support functions such as gcd, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and normalization for a rational number library, including functions for handling edge cases and precision-based snapping to zero.

methods.name: gcdrat
methods.description: Reduces a rational number by dividing numerator and denominator by their GCD.

methods.name: fracrat
methods.description: Converts a rational to its fractional form, simplifying if necessary.

methods.name: mulrat
methods.description: Multiplies a rational number by another rational.

methods.name: divrat
methods.description: Divides a rational number by another rational.

methods.name: subrat
methods.description: Subtracts one rational from another with snapping to zero.

methods.name: _subrat
methods.description: Internal function to subtract rational b from a.

methods.name: addrat
methods.description: Adds two rational numbers with snapping to zero.

methods.name: _addrat
methods.description: Internal function to add rational b to a.

methods.name: rootrat
methods.description: Calculates the root of a rational number.

methods.name: zerrat
methods.description: Checks if a rational number is zero.

methods.name: _snaprat
methods.description: Snaps a rational number to zero if its magnitude is below a threshold.
